summary: Kamal Yassin runs for the Santa Clara Unified School District board with a platform centered on student well-being, technology access, and fiscal leadership. He is a confirmed member of the pro-Palestine Muslim community. CAIR Action endorsed him for the general election, Vote for Peace rated him an Ally, and BAMC Action supported his candidacy, citing his no-nonsense approach to district and curriculum challenges. Samir Laymoun also supported Yassin's run.
